intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “The route is still on my mind. So is our last conversation about it.”

intro.speaker: PLAYER
intro.text: “Last time, I answered a different question from the one you asked.”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “I did not need saving or forbidding.”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “What I need is to know we can make hard decisions together, without one of us vanishing into the other’s plans.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: The chart is back on its ledge. Every circle is still there.

options.labelText: “You pick where and when. I’ll help find safe meeting spots, we’re honest about duties and risks, and I won’t decide for you.”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “You may yet become a capable navigator of discussions. Your knowledge of actual water remains a separate matter.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She picks up the pencil and starts revising the route. You are trusted with holding the stone.

options.labelText: “I thought it over. Let me arrange all of it. One less thing for you to worry about.”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “You listened with remarkable care and somehow missed the middle of every sentence.”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “Then next time, start with the middle.”
